baseUrl.label: Store Address
baseUrl.description: Your store's host name, such as mystore.com. A leading https:// is fine; a store in a subfolder, such as mystore.com/shop, is not supported.

consumerKey.label: Consumer Key
consumerKey.description: Starts with ck_. Created under Settings > Advanced > REST API.

consumerSecret.label: Consumer Secret
consumerSecret.description: Starts with cs_. WooCommerce shows it only once.

add_order_note.label: Add Order Note
add_order_note.description: Add a private or customer-facing note to an order.

id.label: Order ID
id.description: The number after # in WooCommerce > Orders.

note.label: Note
note.description: Shown in the order's notes in WooCommerce.

customer_note.label: Visible to Customer
customer_note.description: Email the note to the customer and show it on the order page.

batch_update_products.label: Batch Update Products
batch_update_products.description: Update the price, stock or status of up to 100 products in one call.

updates.label: Updates
updates.description: One entry per product, 1 to 100 entries. Each needs the product id and at least one field to change.

create_coupon.label: Create Coupon

code.label: Code
code.description: Coupon code customers enter at checkout. Must be unique.

discount_type.label: Discount Type
discount_type.description: Percentage off the cart, a fixed amount off the cart, or a fixed amount off each product.

amount.label: Amount
amount.description: Discount amount as a decimal string: a percentage for percentage coupons, otherwise money, e.g. 10.

date_expires.label: Expiry Date
date_expires.description: The coupon stops working after this date.

minimum_amount.label: Minimum Spend
minimum_amount.description: Minimum cart subtotal needed to use the coupon, e.g. 50.00.

maximum_amount.label: Maximum Spend
maximum_amount.description: Maximum cart subtotal allowed when using the coupon.

individual_use.label: Individual Use Only
individual_use.description: Yes stops this coupon from being combined with other coupons. Leave empty for the store default (No).

exclude_sale_items.label: Exclude Sale Items
exclude_sale_items.description: Yes stops the coupon from applying to items already on sale. Leave empty for the store default (No).

free_shipping.label: Free Shipping
free_shipping.description: Yes lets the coupon unlock free shipping, if a free-shipping method is set up. Leave empty for the store default (No).

usage_limit.label: Usage Limit
usage_limit.description: How many times the coupon can be used in total.

usage_limit_per_user.label: Usage Limit Per Customer
usage_limit_per_user.description: How many times each customer can use the coupon.

product_ids.label: Product IDs
product_ids.description: Ids of the only products the coupon applies to.

excluded_product_ids.label: Excluded Product IDs
excluded_product_ids.description: Ids of products the coupon never applies to.

email_restrictions.label: Allowed Emails
email_restrictions.description: Only customers with these billing emails can use the coupon.

create_customer.label: Create Customer
create_customer.description: Create a customer account. Only the email is required.

email.label: Email
email.description: Email address of the customer. Must not already be registered.

username.label: Username
username.description: Login name. Generated from the email when empty and the store allows it.

password.label: Password
password.description: Account password. Generated when empty and the store allows it.

billing_state.label: Billing State
billing_state.description: State or county code, e.g. CA.

billing_country.label: Billing Country
billing_country.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. US.

shipping_state.label: Shipping State
shipping_state.description: State or county code, e.g. CA.

shipping_country.label: Shipping Country
shipping_country.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. US.

create_order.label: Create Order
create_order.description: Create an order with one or more line items.

line_items.label: Line Items
line_items.description: Products to include in the order.

customer_id.label: Customer ID
customer_id.description: Leave empty for a guest order.

billing_email.label: Billing Email
billing_email.description: Where WooCommerce sends the order emails.

payment_method.label: Payment Method ID
payment_method.description: Gateway ID, e.g. bacs, cheque or cod.

payment_method_title.label: Payment Method Title
payment_method_title.description: Name the customer sees, e.g. Direct bank transfer.

create_order_refund.label: Create Order Refund
create_order_refund.description: Refund an amount on an order. By default the refund is only recorded in WooCommerce.

order_id.label: Order ID
order_id.description: Id of the order to refund.

amount.label: Amount
amount.description: Amount to refund as a decimal string, e.g. 10.00. Cannot exceed what is left to refund on the order.

reason.label: Reason
reason.description: Reason for the refund, stored with the refund.

refund_via_gateway.label: Refund Via Gateway
refund_via_gateway.description: When on, the money is actually sent back to the customer through the payment gateway. When off (the default) the refund is only recorded in WooCommerce.

create_product.label: Create Product
create_product.description: Create a product. Only the name is required.

status.label: Status
status.description: Defaults to published, which makes the product visible in the shop.

regular_price.label: Regular Price
regular_price.description: Price as a decimal string, e.g. 19.99.

sale_price.label: Sale Price
sale_price.description: Discounted price as a decimal string. Must be lower than the regular price.

sku.label: SKU
sku.description: Stock keeping unit. Must be unique in the store.

description.label: Description
description.description: Full product description. HTML is allowed.

short_description.label: Short Description
short_description.description: Short summary shown near the price. HTML is allowed.

category_ids.label: Category IDs
category_ids.description: Ids of the categories to put the product in. Find them with List Product Categories.

tag_ids.label: Tag IDs
tag_ids.description: Ids of the tags to attach. Find them with List Product Tags.

image_urls.label: Image URLs
image_urls.description: Public image URLs. The first one becomes the main image. The store downloads each one, so an unreachable URL fails the call.

stock_quantity.label: Stock Quantity
stock_quantity.description: Units in stock. Setting it turns on stock management for the product.

stock_status.label: Stock Status
stock_status.description: Stock status. Ignored when a stock quantity is set, because the quantity decides it.

create_product_category.label: Create Product Category

parent_id.label: Parent Category ID
parent_id.description: Id of the parent category. Leave empty for a top-level category.

slug.label: Slug
slug.description: URL-friendly name. Generated from the name when empty.

create_product_tag.label: Create Product Tag

slug.label: Slug
slug.description: URL-friendly name. Generated from the name when empty.

delete_coupon.label: Delete Coupon
delete_coupon.description: Move a coupon to the trash, or delete it permanently.

coupon_id.label: Coupon ID
coupon_id.description: Id of the coupon to delete.

permanent.label: Delete Permanently
permanent.description: When off (the default) the coupon is moved to the trash and can be restored from the WordPress admin. When on it is deleted for good.

delete_customer.label: Delete Customer

customer_id.label: Customer ID
customer_id.description: Id of the customer to delete. Find it with List Customers.

reassign_to_user_id.label: Reassign To User ID
reassign_to_user_id.description: Optional id of another user who takes over the posts owned by the deleted customer. Must differ from the customer id.

delete_order.label: Delete Order
delete_order.description: Move an order to the trash, or delete it permanently.

order_id.label: Order ID
order_id.description: Id of the order to delete. Find it with List Orders.

permanent.label: Delete Permanently
permanent.description: When off (the default) the order is moved to the trash and can be restored from the WordPress admin. When on it is deleted for good.

delete_order_note.label: Delete Order Note
delete_order_note.description: Permanently delete a note from an order.

order_id.label: Order ID
order_id.description: Id of the order the note belongs to.

note_id.label: Note ID
note_id.description: Id of the note to delete.

delete_product.label: Delete Product
delete_product.description: Move a product to the trash, or delete it permanently.

product_id.label: Product ID
product_id.description: Id of the product to delete. Find it with List Products.

permanent.label: Delete Permanently
permanent.description: When off (the default) the product is moved to the trash and can be restored from the WordPress admin. When on it is deleted for good.

get_customer.label: Get Customer

get_order.label: Get Order

get_order_totals_report.description: Get the number of orders in each status.

get_product.label: Get Product
get_product.description: Get a product by its ID.

id.label: Product ID
id.description: Find it in WooCommerce under Products, next to each product.

get_product_variation.label: Get Product Variation
get_product_variation.description: Get one variation of a variable product.

product_id.label: Product ID
product_id.description: Id of the parent variable product.

get_sales_report.label: Get Sales Report
get_sales_report.description: Get sales totals for a period or date range.

period.label: Period
period.description: Preset period to report on. Leave empty when using a date range; if both are empty the current week is used.

date_min.label: Start Date
date_min.description: First day of a custom range, as YYYY-MM-DD. Use together with End Date instead of Period.

date_max.label: End Date
date_max.description: Last day of a custom range, as YYYY-MM-DD. Use together with Start Date instead of Period.

get_top_sellers_report.label: Get Top Sellers Report
get_top_sellers_report.description: Get the best-selling products for a period or date range.

period.label: Period
period.description: Preset period to report on. Leave empty when using a date range; if both are empty the current week is used.

date_min.label: Start Date
date_min.description: First day of a custom range, as YYYY-MM-DD. Use together with End Date instead of Period.

date_max.label: End Date
date_max.description: Last day of a custom range, as YYYY-MM-DD. Use together with Start Date instead of Period.

list_coupons.label: List Coupons
list_coupons.description: List coupons, or find one by its exact code.

search.label: Search
search.description: Text to match against coupon codes and descriptions.

after.label: Created After
after.description: Only return coupons created after this date and time (ISO 8601).

before.label: Created Before
before.description: Only return coupons created before this date and time (ISO 8601).

page.label: Page
page.description: Page number, starting at 1. If a page comes back with exactly per_page items, request the next page to see more.

per_page.label: Per Page
per_page.description: Number of items per page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 10.

list_customers.label: List Customers
list_customers.description: List customers, filtered by email, text or role.

search.label: Search
search.description: Text to match against names, usernames and emails.

role.label: Role
role.description: WordPress role to return. Defaults to all roles.

orderby.label: Sort By
orderby.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to name.

order.label: Sort Direction
order.description: Ascending or descending. Defaults to ascending.

list_order_notes.description: List the notes on an order.

type.label: Note Type

list_order_refunds.label: List Order Refunds
list_order_refunds.description: List the refunds recorded on an order.

list_orders.description: List orders, filtered by status, customer, product, text or date range.

status.label: Status
status.description: Only return orders with this status. Leave empty for any status except trash.

customer_id.label: Customer ID
customer_id.description: Only return orders placed by this customer. Find the id with List Customers.

product_id.label: Product ID

list_payment_gateways.afterResponse:
return response.map((gateway) => ({id: gateway.id, title: gateway.title, description: gateway.description, order: gateway.order, enabled: gateway.enabled,
  method_title: gateway.method_title, method_description: gateway.method_description, method_supports: gateway.method_supports}));
